patch.value: preflight: fail-fast Jira credential validation gate

Add a registerPreflight credential-validation gate that aborts network-mutating pm-jira commands (jira sync, jira import, jira export --push) BEFORE any pm-store read or Jira REST call when JIRA_BASE_URL/JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN are missing. Makes the long-standing 'preflight' capability claim (CHANGELOG / pm-jira-4804 / pm-jira-vfb3) actually true.

value.author: codex
value.text: Env vars validated: JIRA_BASE_URL (or --host override), JIRA_EMAIL, JIRA_API_TOKEN — the exact trio resolveCreds()/diagnoseCreds() already use. The gate reuses the existing offline, secret-safe diagnoseCreds() helper (no new network calls, never echoes token/email).

value.author: codex
value.text: Scoping (isMutatingJiraInvocation): fires ONLY for ctx.command in {'jira sync','jira import'} without --dry-run, and 'jira export' only when --push set and not --dry-run. Deliberately exempts: jira validate (diagnostics), all --dry-run previews, jira export without --push (offline payload print), and every non-pm-jira command. pm normalizes flags to camelCase so readBooleanOption reads both --dry-run/dryRun and --push/push.

value.author: codex
value.text: KEY SDK FINDING: the pm-cli preflight-override runtime (extension-hook-runtime.js runPreflightOverride) wraps the callback in try/catch that SWALLOWS any throw into a non-fatal warning (extension_preflight_override_failed) and lets the command proceed. beforeCommand hooks do the same. So a bare throw CANNOT fail-fast. To genuinely abort before the command body, the override prints the actionable message to stderr and calls process.exit(EXIT_CODE.USAGE=2) — process termination bypasses the runtime catch. Proven functionally.

value.author: codex
value.text: Manifest: added 'preflight' to capabilities array (gates activation — without it the override never loads). Updated index.ts header capability docs + README Features bullet + new 'Preflight gate' section + table.

value.author: codex
value.text: Bug also fixed: runImport() called resolveCreds() BEFORE the --dry-run branch, so 'pm jira sync/import --project X --dry-run' wrongly required creds. Reordered so dry-run resolves a base URL from --host/JIRA_BASE_URL (else placeholder) WITHOUT requiring email/token — matching the exporter's offline dry-run and making the preflight's 'skip dry-run' correct/consistent.

value.author: codex
value.text: FUNCTIONAL TEST EVIDENCE (scratch workspace /tmp/scratch-jira, local build installed via pm install --project, creds unset via env -u). BAD-CREDS ABORTS (exit 2): 'pm jira sync --project PROJ' -> 'pm-jira preflight: cannot run "pm jira sync" — missing Jira credentials: JIRA_BASE_URL (or --host), JIRA_EMAIL, JIRA_API_TOKEN ...' EXIT=2. Same for 'jira import' (EXIT=2) and 'jira export --push --project PROJ' (EXIT=2).

value.author: codex
value.text: FUNCTIONAL TEST EVIDENCE — must-NOT-block paths all EXIT=0: 'pm jira validate' prints readiness (NOT READY) exit 0; 'pm jira sync --project PROJ --dry-run' prints [dry-run] JQL+GET exit 0; 'pm jira import --project PROJ --dry-run' exit 0 (confirms dry-run-creds bug fixed); 'pm jira export' (no push) prints [] exit 0. GOOD-CREDS PASS-THROUGH: with dummy JIRA_* set, 'pm jira sync --project PROJ' passes preflight silently ('Fetching issues from Jira...') and only fails later at network (ENOTFOUND example.invalid, exit 1) — NOT a preflight abort, proving the gate distinguishes present vs missing creds.

patch.value: registerPreflight override added (scoped to network-mutating jira sync/import + export --push, skips --dry-run/validate); validates JIRA_BASE_URL/JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN via existing diagnoseCreds; aborts via stderr+process.exit(2) because the runtime swallows thrown errors. 'preflight' added to manifest capabilities. Also fixed runImport dry-run-requires-creds ordering bug.

Mutating jira commands with missing creds abort immediately (exit 2, clear message) before any pm-store/Jira call; validate + --dry-run + export-without-push remain creds-free; good creds pass through silently.

All confirmed in scratch workspace: sync/import/export --push abort exit 2 with preflight message; validate/dry-run(x2)/export-no-push exit 0; good (dummy) creds pass preflight and fail only at network. typecheck+build clean; 50/50 tests pass.
Implemented and functionally verified the fail-fast preflight credential gate; makes the prior 'preflight' capability claim true.
